completion_criteria.text: 0092 diagnosis: the merge-boundary preflight never exits non-zero with empty stdout again - every non-zero exit emits a human-readable reason, and running the CLI directly with no MITOSIS_BOUNDARY_* env prints why it refused. Proven by executing the real CLI in that exact unconfigured state and reading its output.

0092 posture: a decision record settles whether the unconfigured boundary halts the run or degrades with a surfaced warning, and the engine implements what that record decides. The record must state the security trade-off explicitly, since fail-closed is what currently makes the engine unusable.

0092 receipt: a test execs the real preflight CLI end-to-end instead of stubbing the verdict, and it is RED when the step-7 call site is severed and GREEN when it is wired. The red state is demonstrated by actually severing the call site in a scratch copy, not asserted.

0093: gate identity stops being string equality on an unresolved path - the gate resolves a real path, or is relocated outside the repo it manages. A test redirects the path to a different file and asserts the gate refuses rather than trusting it.

0094: the config guard covers git worktrees - a write to a guarded path inside a real git worktree of this repo is held for human confirmation, asserted by a test that builds an actual worktree fixture rather than simulating one.

Each of the above lands as its own MSP through the centralized pr-create tool, and origin/main is verified fully green (full suite, exit 0) after each merge - re-derived from the remote, never from a possibly-stale local main.

spine.active_goal: Two tracks. (1) 0099: the merge boundary is ONE honest gate - posture CLOSED. (2) 0100/0101: pin the global install to a detached origin/main worktree at ~/.claude-install, safeguards BEFORE the pin. MSP A is SHIPPED (PR #13). All four safeguard steps are DESIGNED but NOT IMPLEMENTED; the implementable spec is docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-29-install-pin-safeguards.md.
spine.next_step: FIRST commit the UNTRACKED spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-29-install-pin-safeguards.md on a fresh branch off origin/main, never onto feat/centralized-pr-creation. Then implement in ratified order, one MSP and one PR each: (1) drift-state relocation and fail-loud rewrite (hook body is in the spec; the file removal needs human confirmation); (2) freshness check; (3) deny and chmod; (4) migration script plus the new install-pin-applied marker.
open_risks: The spec file is UNTRACKED and lives only in the primary checkout working tree. It is the sole artifact of the whole design phase. Commit it FIRST next session or a git clean can lose it.

R4 UNAPPLIED. Until the pin lands ~/.claude serves the primary checkout on feat/centralized-pr-creation, so the merge-boundary gate is absent from the live install and MSP B/C are inert - they edit code that is not there.
Corroborated this session: a design agent reading the LIVE guard found no worktree enumeration, because the live install predates MSP A. 0100's diagnosis reproducing in the wild.
PREREQUISITE still live: superpowers-drift-check.sh:4 writes .drift-state.json, a TRACKED file, currently MODIFIED. Step 1 must land before the pin or the install worktree is permanently dirty.
PRESERVE mv -fh. Verified against this machine's man mv: -f only suppresses the prompt; -h is the actual guard against following a symlink-to-directory.
The 38-link constant is a point-in-time snapshot; any new farm symlink makes preflight abort. That is INTENDED - do not 'fix' it by deleting the check.

Step 3's deny silently upgrades ask to deny for the ~/.claude symlink paths post-pin, since every entry realpaths into the install root. Everyday edits become checkout, PR, merge, auto-refresh. Tell the user.
chmod -R a-w buys NOTHING against a deliberate same-uid actor - the hook chmods the tree writable itself. Never describe it as more than accident-protection.
~/.zshrc still symlinks into the primary checkout - post-pin it is the LAST live-config symlink tracking an unpinned branch. Outside 0100's scope, UNDECIDED.
Designed-around but unverified: whether permissions.deny resolves symlinks; the hook-timeout signal; whether SessionStart stdout reaches context on nonzero exit; checkout's unlink-vs-truncate.
PROCESS, reaffirmed: subagent self-reports are NOT trustworthy. This session re-ran MSP A's suites and re-read the diff directly before pushing rather than believing the implementer's report.
